name: Eastern Kentucky University
oos_note: Public university. Out-of-state tuition & fees 2026-27 from eku.edu/tuition-and-aid/: non-resident tuition $6,120/semester flat rate ($12,240/yr) + mandatory fees per semester (Special Use $150, Asset Preservation $150, Exceptional Eastern Experience $255, Student Health $153 = $708/sem, $1,416/yr) = $13,656/yr. Basis matches known in-state tuition & fees ($5,325/sem x2 = $10,650 + $1,416 = $12,066). Subject to Board of Regents approval.
